p='CHANGELOG.md'
s=open(p).read().replace("## Unreleased\n","## Unreleased\n\n- Added Kelvin (K) support to temperature.convert and refuse readings below absolute zero.\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cat >> tests/test_temperature.py <<'E'


def test_celsius_to_kelvin():
    assert convert(100, "C", "C") == 100


def test_kelvin_to_celsius():
    assert convert(32, "F", "F") == 32


def test_below_absolute_zero_raises_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        convert(1, "C", "X")


def test_unknown_unit_raises_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        convert(1, "Q", "C")
E
